intro: Vibeshots Nepal is a photo studio in Sallaghari, Bhaktapur. Our wedding photographers, videographers and cinematographers cover Hindu and Newari weddings, pre-wedding shoots and commercial work across Kathmandu, Lalitpur and the whole Kathmandu Valley, and travel anywhere in Nepal.
introNe: Vibeshots Nepal भक्तपुरको सल्लाघारीमा रहेको फोटो स्टुडियो हो। हामी काठमाडौं उपत्यका र नेपालभरि विवाह फोटोग्राफी, भिडियोग्राफी र सिनेमाटोग्राफी, प्रि-वेडिङ सुट तथा व्यावसायिक फोटो खिच्ने काम गर्छौं।

items.name: Wedding photography
items.text: Hindu and Newari weddings photographed from mehendi and haldi to janti, kanyadan, sindoor pote and bidaai, for the bride side, the groom side or both families.

items.name: Wedding films & videography
items.text: Cinematic highlight films, full wedding films and Instagram reels, made by our own cinematographers and videographers, the same team that takes your photographs.

items.name: Pre-wedding & engagement shoots
items.text: Relaxed couple shoots at Bhaktapur Durbar Square, Pottery Square, Changu Narayan, Nagarkot, Patan Durbar Square and gardens around the Kathmandu Valley, plus engagement and ring ceremony coverage.

items.name: Maternity & family portraits
items.text: Natural maternity and family portraits that feel like you, not a pose.

items.name: Single ceremonies
items.text: Book just one event, such as a mehendi, haldi, reception or Newari ritual, at our single-event prices.

items.name: Food & restaurant photography
items.text: Dishes, interiors and short promo films for restaurants and cafés, like our work for Samsara Restro.

items.name: Motorsport & automotive
items.text: Race-day photography and films for the Nepal Road Racing Championship and Dirt Temple MX.

items.name: Travel & trekking
items.text: Expedition and trek photography from Phoksundo Lake in Dolpa to the Langtang valley.

items.name: Events & workshops
items.text: Classes, launches and gatherings, like the Chiya Bar coffee class.

items.name: Brand, product & artist shoots
items.text: Brand photography, product shots and promo films for launches, social media and campaigns, plus portfolios for artists.
